# Retoucher

> Your coding agent, inside Figma. Leave notes on your Figma layers. Claude Code, Codex or Cursor picks them up, edits the Figma file through the Figma MCP, shows its steps live, and asks its questions and permission prompts in the same panel inside Figma.

Retoucher has two parts: an agent plugin (starts a local bridge on localhost:4747 and teaches the agent how to handle notes) and a Figma plugin (the panel the designer writes notes in). Everything stays on the designer's computer.

## Setup prompt

Set up Retoucher for me. It lets me leave notes on my Figma layers that you pick up, apply in the Figma file and answer in a panel inside Figma.

1. Install the Retoucher agent plugin for the agent you are:
   - Claude Code: run `claude plugin install retoucher --marketplace alicorak/retoucher`
   - Codex: run `codex plugin marketplace add alicorak/retoucher`, then install it from /plugins and tell me to trust its hooks once
   - Cursor: run `git clone https://github.com/alicorak/retoucher.git ~/.retoucher-plugin` and `mkdir -p ~/.cursor/plugins/local && ln -s ~/.retoucher-plugin ~/.cursor/plugins/local/retoucher`, then tell me to restart Cursor
2. Check that Node.js 18 or newer is installed and that the Figma MCP server is connected. If either is missing, tell me exactly how to fix it.
3. Add the Retoucher Figma plugin. It's waiting for Figma Community review, so it comes with the agent plugin: get the path of its manifest (Claude Code: `retoucher figma-plugin`, or `node <plugin folder>/bridge/cli.mjs figma-plugin\

## Links

- [Source and docs](https://github.com/alicorak/retoucher#readme)
- [Retoucher Playground](https://www.figma.com/community/file/1702413212702310844/retoucher-playground): a Figma file of hands-on exercises, one feature per card
- [How the agent handles a note](https://github.com/alicorak/retoucher/blob/main/skills/handle-figma-notes/SKILL.md)

## Docs

- [Get started](https://retoucher.alicorak.com/docs/get-started/): Two halves: an agent plugin on your computer and the panel inside Figma. Your agent installs the first one for you.
- [Your agent & privacy](https://retoucher.alicorak.com/docs/agent-and-privacy/): Retoucher brings no AI of its own, and nothing leaves your computer.
- [Write a note](https://retoucher.alicorak.com/docs/write-a-note/): Point at something in Figma, say what should change, send.
- [While it works](https://retoucher.alicorak.com/docs/while-it-works/): Follow along and steer, without leaving Figma.
- [Results](https://retoucher.alicorak.com/docs/results/): What comes back, and the way back.
- [Options](https://retoucher.alicorak.com/docs/options/): Everything behind the Options button. The button shows what is switched on.
- [In Figma](https://retoucher.alicorak.com/docs/in-figma/): Retoucher in the file itself.
- [Troubleshooting](https://retoucher.alicorak.com/docs/troubleshooting/): The usual cases, and the fix.
